answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 19174 Country: India Title: Will Drinking the milk of wife invalidate nikah? Question: Assalamu-alaikum, Last night when my eight-month old baby and his mother were asleep i drank my wife's breast milk. Now I am afraid because of this foolish act of mine, will my marriage be in trouble. How can I save my marriage. I love my wife very much don't want to loose her in any case. Please give me solution. Answer ID: 19174 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 170/163/H=1431) It is haram and unlawful to drink the milk of wife, but seek forgiveness from Allah sincerely and avoid repeating the action in future. Your nikah is intact; your wife is still in your nikah, drinking will not make her haram . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
